question: The growth rate target for the twelfth five year plan was ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__8%__.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Twelfth Five-Year Plan of India **(2012-2017)** aimed to promote **"faster, sustainable, and more inclusive growth."** 
 
• The actual GDP growth rate during the Twelfth Plan period averaged around 6-6.5%, significantly **lower than the target of 8%**. 
 
• **Infrastructure development** was one of the most critical components, including transport, energy, telecommunications, and urban development. 
 
• The Twelfth Plan sought to create more productive and higher-paying** jobs, **especially in the manufacturing and service sectors.
